entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: An amnesiac mind mage and planeswalker who joins Vraska's crew, rediscovers his telepathy, and solves how the thaumatic compass works.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon captain of The Belligerent who confides her imprisonment by the Azorius and her hope to lead the Golgari.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: The siren navigator of The Belligerent who explains the history of the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: The quartermaster and helmsmage of The Belligerent who teaches Jace sailing.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin crewman skilled at knots and loud chanting who owes Amelia money.

entities.name: Kerrigan
entities.description: The burly orc ship's cook.

entities.name: Gavven
entities.description: The boatswain of The Belligerent who showed Jace the ship's hull.

entities.name: Lord Nicolas
entities.description: The wealthy overseas patron who hired Vraska to retrieve the Immortal Sun and promised her leadership of the Golgari; a telepath who may be better than Jace.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: A ruler whose forces broke into the monastery and stole the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: River Herald Merfolk
entities.description: A green-finned merfolk in the tavern who silently protests when Vraska names Orazca.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's schooner, which is wrecked on rocks in a storm at the end of the story.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A magical compass with several needles that Jace repairs, discovering it points to a particular kind of magical expression.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A powerful relic once kept in the monasteries of Torrezon, stolen and then carried west by a winged being.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The forgotten city of power where the Immortal Sun lies.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A floating pirate town built from broken Brazen Coalition ships, a neutral ground for pirates.

entities.name: Boatswain's Rear
entities.description: A seedy tavern in High and Dry that Malcolm likes.

entities.name: Burning Port
entities.description: A venue the crew plans to visit for ale and cards.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The massive snowy guild city that Vraska describes and Jace illusions.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane whose shores the ship nears.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The old eastern kingdom whose monasteries held the Immortal Sun and where war rages.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampires who arrived on Ixalan two years ago and whose ship approaches The Belligerent.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate alliance whose broken ships form High and Dry.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of lawmakers that arrested Vraska and Golgari members and imprisoned them.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that runs the bank.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that technically runs refuse and rot farms, which Vraska hopes to lead.

events.summary: Jace spends days learning sailing and honing his illusions among the crew as the ship sails.
events.quote: He set about making a place for himself among the crew and relished learning new tasks and techniques.

events.summary: The Belligerent lands at High and Dry, where the crew disembarks for revelry.
events.quote: the crew landed at High and Dry with no need for expensive supplies.

events.summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
events.quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

events.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
events.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

events.summary: Malcolm explains the history of the Immortal Sun, stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
events.quote: a winged being descended from the sky. It took the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Vraska tells Jace he is something else entirely.
Jace asks if he can read minds, and Vraska confirms telepathically; he learns to silence the voices.
Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
Jace half-remembers a winged lion with a man's face and worries about the minds he may have broken.
events.quote: I wonder how many minds I have broken before,

events.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
events.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

events.summary: Jace encourages Vraska that she is meant to be a great leader, and each realizes neither wants to hurt the other.
events.quote: Both of them realized at the exact same moment that neither of them wanted to hurt the other.

events.summary: Jace disassembles and repairs the thaumatic compass, then triggers his planeswalker spark and sees the needle point at him.
events.quote: And felt his body break apart and away and slam back together, with the familiar triangle appearing above his head once more.

events.summary: Jace theorizes the compass points to a specific kind of magical expression and that Orazca must be a massive hub of such energy.
events.quote: the Golden City would have to be a massive hub of magical energy

events.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
events.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

events.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
events.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

relations.note: hired her to retrieve the Immortal Sun and promised guildleadership
relations.quote: His name is Lord Nicolas, and he hired me to retrieve an item of great power.
On the captain's orders, the crew of The Belligerent disembarked

relations.note: newest member of her crew, calls her captain
relations.quote: Malcolm and I need to consult with our newest crewmember.
the Azorius issued a mass arrest warrant for members of the Golgari guild.
I'm proud to know you, too, Jace.

relations.note: his forces stole it from the monastery
relations.quote: Pedron the Wicked's forces broke into the monastery where the Immortal Sun was kept safe and stole it.

relations.note: the forgotten city on the continent Vraska was sent to
relations.quote: He told me to make for the continent of Ixalan.
Captain, Beleren, this way, if you will.
